text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've made up my mind to change.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Enough is enough. I can't keep forcing
Wonder
Acute to do things my way.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Policy! Here at Tracen Academy, we put
the
Umamusume first!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Their needs are your top priority, no
matter the
circumstances! Never forget
that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think back on Director Akikawa's
words. The
most fundamental aspect of
training is respect for
your trainee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As trainers, we should adjust our
methods to suit
their needs rather than
force our views on them.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmph. The basics, huh?
choice_data_list: Back to basics, one more time!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"A trainer's role is to draw out an
Umamusume's
full potential. A trainer
must be devoted to that
cause."

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I daresay something like that is running
through
your head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right on the money. It's impossible
to
properly train an Umamusume if you
neglect the
fundamentals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll go back to square one and start my
training
journey all over again. Then
surely—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At a glance, it seems logical. However...
Aren't
you forgetting something crucial?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You're forgetting what kind of
Umamusume
Wonder Acute is.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You're forgetting she is not the
Overlord.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand what she's getting at.
Of
course Wonder Acute isn't T.M.
Opera O...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What is she trying to tell me? I rack my
brain as
she continues...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If she were the Overlord, you'd needn't do
anything more than follow along. She
would claim
her throne, provided you
didn't get in the way.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For that is the essence of the Overlord.
Your role
would simply be to humor her
desires.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably for you both, she is not the
Overlord.
But it is not only her. In fact,
almost no one is.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The vast majority are not born fit for the
crown.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
When training such an individual, do you
truly believe that simply smiling
cheerfully as you watch over her
progress is enough to lead her to the
top?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Sure, the idea of going back to basics
has a pleasant ring to it, but is it not
simply shying
away from the road you
must walk?
choice_data_list: Just smile brightly... and watch o...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Are you not merely afraid of the pain
that you must put yourself and your
trainee through if you're to tread the
thorny road that leads to the
top?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You mustn't misunderstand. Our world is
not so
forgiving that anyone can become
a star by
simply existing.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Each year is an audition where thousands
of
Umamusume jostle for a chance at the
spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O takes a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Your supposedly harsh training method
is one solution to this predicament.
Provided it is
meticulously thought-out,
that is.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Acute acknowledges that fact. So why is
it you
intend to turn away?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do not avert your gaze for lack of
confidence.
Your role is to keep your
eyes fixed on what's in
front of you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Maintain a keen focus—on your actions,
on your
beliefs... and on Wonder Acute
most of all.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: In other words... Open your eyes, fool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Confidence doesn't come that easily. My
time here at Tracen Academy has been
filled with
nothing but missteps and
failures.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I simply close my eyes and clench my
teeth.
There's no way I can face reality
when I have no
idea wh—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So you intend to shy away from it all, do
you?
Well then...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Overlord shall make you see! I will
open
those eyes by force if I must!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That feeble body of yours may as well
be a
toothpick in the face of an
Umamusume's raw
power.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Grit your teeth! For you and this
concrete are
about to have a painful
rendezvous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time I register what's happening,
it's too
late.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Overlord Shoulder Throw! YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, my body is in the air!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel my body twist before crashing
down onto
my back! A small jolt zips up
my spine, and my
eyes fly open.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There, looking up from the hard ground,
I see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A vast blue sky that seems to go on
forever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yes, this sky is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
One more, Trainer! I've got another lap
in me. I've
still got plenty of zip in these
legs!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the same sky I've gazed up at with
Wonder
Acute all this time. It hasn't
changed at all.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, listen well. You must not create a
ceiling for
yourself.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's a barrier that confines you, narrows
your
surroundings, and brings misfortune
to all.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Break free—for your sake, and for
Acute's as well.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No tale worth telling is devoid of
hardship. An
azure sky always awaits
beyond dark clouds.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Forget about your own circumstances.
Look your
companion right in the eyes
and tell her what is
going on.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I believe that will more than suffice.

...Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...The pain in my back subsides before I
realize it.
She must have controlled the
throw to minimize
the damage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After T.M. Opera O leaves, all that
remains is the
big blue sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Look your companion right in the eyes
and tell her what's going on." I mull over
those words on
my way to the training
grounds.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... She said I should be able to
"down load"
it with a few tappity taps,
but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
These "app" thingamajigs are hard. I
know how to
check my messages, at
least...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer! Um...
This isn't what it looks
like... I
swear...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll be able to do it on my own.
That
way, I won't need to pester you
with questions
every five seconds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look at the device in Wonder Acute's
hands and see a flip phone. Suddenly, it
dawns on me...
Wonder Acute doesn't
have a smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The nutrition app wouldn't work on a flip
phone... but it looks like she doesn't
know that! No wonder she's been so
tired lately—she hasn't been using
it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, thank you for printing out all the

information from the app for me, dear.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just look at all the food I have to eat
every day.
Why, this is very different
from what I imagined.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Um. Like?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Weeell... There is one thing. I thought it
would
take care of itself in time if I just
pushed through
it, but...
choice_data_list: Something you were too hesitant to...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've had some stinging pain in
my
toenails lately.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad she told me about this. Wonder
Acute's nails are small, and they haven't
been growing in
line with the rest of her
body...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'd never be able to endure an even
harder
training regimen in this state. We
need to treat
this immediately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rub, rub, rub, rub!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Heeheehee! Goodness, that tickles!
Yaaah, that
tickles!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but my toes do feel better now.
What is that
ointment?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Pain-B-Gone?! Well, with a name like
that, no
wonder my toes stopped
hurting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The name might be silly, but this stuff
works like a charm. It's the latest nail
repair gel for
Umamusume who have thin
nails.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as she protects her nails and
eats a
nutritious diet, then Wonder
Acute will surely—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: NNNGRAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhh! No matter how much I run, I
don't feel out
of breath or dizzy at all!
And my heart rate's just
dandy!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... and I'm so sorry for all the
worry I've
caused you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you need to apologize for?
choice_data_list: I'm the one who should... apologize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute and I have accomplished
much
together, yet I haven't been able
to get over my
past weakness.
choice_data_list: Sorry I just couldn't find any con...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But things will be different from now on.
I won't
look away anymore.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm not too sure I understand, but...
there, there,
dearie. Do cheer up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
By the way, could you make my basic
training a bit more rough-and-tumble? I
want to be in peak
shape for the Japan
Dirt Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that we can look each other in the
eyes and express our honest feelings,
the bond between us
has grown stronger
than ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now, we're finally ready to face the big
one—the
Japan Dirt Derby.
